title: Nexez Agentic Commerce
description: Search merchants, inspect structured offers, and validate checkout or negotiation before buying.
summary: Search merchants, inspect structured offers, and validate checkout or negotiation before buying.
offersHint: Search merchants, inspect structured offers, and validate checkout or negotiation before buying. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://nexez.app/mcp

toolsPreview.name: nexez_search
toolsPreview.description: Search across all Nexez merchants for services/products matching a buyer request. Returns ranked listings with offers + agent.json URLs.

toolsPreview.name: nexez_directory
toolsPreview.description: Browse the cross-merchant Nexez directory (optionally filtered by category, query, minimum readiness, or location).

toolsPreview.name: nexez_get_page
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a listing's full structured agent manifest (seller profile, offers, actions) by slug.

toolsPreview.name: nexez_validate_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Dry-run a checkout for an offer BEFORE paying — validates the offer, currency, and payment readiness. Never charges.

toolsPreview.name: nexez_validate_negotiation
toolsPreview.description: Dry-run a negotiation proposal against the seller’s rules BEFORE submitting. Returns the rules evaluation. Never writes.
